senses.gloss: (b. h.) [to whisper,] be silent, quiet (cmp. דום, דמם). Part. (fr. חוּשׁ) חָשׁ, f. חָשָׁה, pl. חָשׁוֹת.
units: <cite ref="Chagigah 12b:7">Ḥag. 12ᵇ</cite> <he>אומרות … וחשות ביום וכ׳</he> say praise by night, and are silent by day.
Ib. 13ᵇ (play on ח̇ש̇מ̇ל̇) חיות עתים ח̇ש̇ות … ממ̇ל̇לות Ms. M. Ḥayoth (v. חַיָּה I end) who at times are silent etc.
